entry_points: B10 constructs UpperStore(task_store); recover() runs in the constructor.
known_issues: Suffix continuation is intentionally absent: reserve_batch returns the existing batch, so segment 3 of a send_count=2 plan stays pending for the whole round.
recover() only touches records that were still in flight at start-up; a terminal delivery_unknown is never revisited.
payload_hash() reimplements the C01 recipe rather than importing upper_contracts (B00 owns that file). It is injectable via hasher=; verify equality once both branches are merged.
rollback: Disable the feature; upper_* tables remain and older builds ignore them.
